text: At its virtual meeting held on June 19, 2020, the Toronto Police Services Board was in receipt of a report dated May 26, 2020, from Chief of Police Mark Saunders, regarding the 2019 Annual Hate Crime Statistical Report. The Board received Chief’s Saunders’ report and agreed that a copy of this report be forwarded to the City of Toronto Executive Committee for information. A copy of the Board Minute P107/2020 regarding this matter is attached.
The Executive Committee received the letter (July 23, 2020) from the Toronto Police Services Board for information.
